claim seen;
evidence a from "isolated withdrawal"; renewable a window 1;
evidence b from "independently rooted withdrawal"; renewable b window 1;
evidence sensor from "synthetic sensor";
evidence other from "synthetic guard";
readings r from sensor window 1;
readings kept from sensor window 1;
state held = 0; state divisor = 1; state counter = 0;
event start; event advance; event skip; event decide;
event fail; event continue; event release;
on start renew a;
on start reveal a supports seen;
on start withdraw a because a;
on start renew b;
on start reveal b supports seen;
on start withdraw b because b;
on start set held = qualified(1, b);
on start reveal other;
on start sample r = 1 supports seen;
on start sample kept = latest(r) supports seen;
on advance renew a;
on advance renew b;
on advance sample r = 2 supports seen;
on skip when qualified(0, other) > 0 sample kept = 3 supports seen;
on decide commit trust because enough using latest(kept);
on fail set held = 0;
on fail set divisor = 0;
on continue set counter = counter + 1;
on release set held = 0;
bind hud.guard = 1 / divisor;
bind hud.held = held;
